title: Hallucinate – Massively Multiplayer Online Rave
summary: Hallucinate is a web-based massively multiplayer online rave platform that allows users to participate in virtual party experiences with real-time audio and visual interactions. The project garnered significant attention on Hacker News with 229 points and 97 comments, indicating strong community interest in innovative social entertainment experiences.
problem_solved: Provides a virtual space for people to experience shared music events and social gatherings online, especially relevant in an era where in-person raves and concerts are limited.
why_valuable: Creates an accessible, creative outlet for collective music experiences that breaks geographic barriers and offers a unique psychedelic visual/social environment for users.
